en: So far they're holding.  Let's turn up the heat...
I have been lost in the Dream. I sense his lifeforce but my powers have not yet grown strong enough to make contact.
Mark my words, I will catch you, imp. And when I do!

Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...
The People of Westfall salute $n, a brave and valiant defender of freedom.
A task presses upon me, but I do not have the time to take care of it myself. Can I entrust you with it?
Monty be me name an' rats be me game.
Oh, $n, wait a minute! There's one more thing! Come back!
Go now, $n. Find Volcor... and remember, the magics protecting you will fail if you interact with anyone, save for talking.
The Light be with ya, $n.
The shield be down! Rise up Atal'ai! Rise up!
We've got no time to waste. This is a really long run! Cover me!
Captain Balinda Stonehearth is dead!  Defeat Vanndar and the battle will be ours!
Go get it!!
Okay, I'll teach you, but I want you to do something for me. This is important, so pay close attention.

I'll tell you what. Since you fancy yourself the hero type, if you can make your way through the Badlands to the Searing Gorge and bring me back something to prove your heroics, I'll see what I can do about getting you a key.$B$BIn the southeasternmost corner of Searing Gorge is a lady almost as tough as me, Margol the Rager. Maybe you should investigate.
Rest your weary bones for a spell.
Generic Text2
Try and make yourself useful, $r. GET ME OUT OF HERE! The High Interrogator has the key.
Laurena is the High Priestess of Stormwind. You can find her in the Catheral of Light in Cathedral Square.
Ye bothered me for that? Ye'd be better off strapping a dead rabbit to yer back and running through a Troll's den than wearing that piece of garbage.
Well met, $N. It is good to see that druids like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.
I present to you the Libram of Resilience.
Do not force my hand, children! I shall use your hides to line my boots.

You guide the spirits in the steel to protect and defend with far more skill than I ever could. The student has surpassed the teacher and now I must send you to where your education may continue. $n, you must seek out Shayis Steelfury in Orgrimmar. She is the finest Armorsmith I have ever known, and she can teach you much.

Well, the way I see it, $n, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.$B$BWe can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.$B$BI'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.
I discovered this cave on our first day here.  I believe the energy in the stone can be used to our advantage.

Ja mon, I be collectin' up the fishy-fishy for the Horde. They gettin' ready for big war in the desert at Ahn'Qiraj, and askin' me to get them $2103w of the spotted yellowtail. But right now we only be havin' $2102w. You here to help?
I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.
A hidden blade up the sleeve can mean the difference between you laying dead in the alley, and your opponent laying face down in his own blood.
Where is Elder Silvervein?
I am ready to hear your tale, Baristolth.
Fresh troops flood to Iceblood Garrison!  Captain Galvangar will soon arrive, and a new battle will soon begin!
One moment while I stitch this together...
My teachings would be too advanced for you at this stage. If you wish to learn more of potions, speak with Tel'Athir here instead.
Ah, to be young again, and to have discovered potions for the first time. Thank you for refreshing my memory, $n. Now go share that youthful enthusiasm with Milla Fairancora over there.
Get up, little red wyrm...and destroy them!

Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.
Children of the Night, heed your Queen's call!
%s shuffles through the books.
Can you not sense the anguish of the Earth Mother for her lost children, the undead? Speak quickly, $n. Every second costs me dearly. We must help them find their way back to her!
Just tell us what you know about the Shady Rest Inn, and I won't bash your skull in.
Stick around after the firework show is over.  Find a goblet and raise it to toast your hardy friends!
Maybe this wasn't the best place for a shop after all...
You honor the spirits of the animals you must slay by not letting them go to waste.  Aska Mistrunner will show you how.  She has a kitchen on the high rise.
What is E'ko?
